```yaml
name: Termux Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly at midnight UTC

jobs:
  install-requirements-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

  install-requirements-full:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install full dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements-full.txt

  termux-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [install-requirements-base, install-requirements-full]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer
```

This workflow includes two jobs to install the base and full requirements, and a third job to run the tests using Termux. The tests are scheduled to run weekly and on pull requests to the main branch.
